overview: The Wausau Board of Public Works met on November 17th and handled three items: approving prior meeting minutes, opening 15 bids for the 2026 demolition of the former MBX South building at 207 North 1st Avenue (with no award made pending funding confirmation), and approving a contractor pay estimate before moving into closed session. The demolition bid opening is significant as it represents a major redevelopment step for the former MBX South site downtown.
presiding: Unknown — presiding officer not named in transcript

agenda.item: Item 1: Approval of minutes from November 10th meeting
Item 2A: Open bids for 2026 demolition of 207 North 1st Avenue (former MBX South)
Item 2B: 2026 Sidewalk Repair Project A — Pember Company Pay Estimate No. 3
Item 3: Closed session pursuant to Wisconsin State Statutes 19.85(1)(g) to deliberate on claims

discussions.body: A board member moved to approve the minutes and another seconded. The motion passed on a voice vote with all members in favor.

discussions.item: 2026 Demolition of 207 North 1st Avenue (Former MBX South) — Bid Opening
discussions.body: Staff (identified as Patrick) read 15 bids aloud, ranging from a low of $150,000 (WS Trucking and Construction) to a high of $440,362.70 (RC Pavers). The apparent low bidder was WS Trucking and Construction at $150,000. No award was made at this time; Patrick explained that community development must first work through funding to confirm the project is ready to proceed, and the item will be brought back to the board.

discussions.item: 2026 Sidewalk Repair Project A — Pember Company Pay Estimate No. 3
discussions.body: Staff presented pay estimate number three from Pember Company in the amount of $8,285 for work to date, as approved by project inspector Matt Guptail. A board member moved to approve the payment, another seconded, and the motion passed unanimously on a voice vote.
The board voted to enter closed session pursuant to Wisconsin State Statutes 19.85(1)(g) for the purpose of deliberating on claims. The motion was seconded and approved on a voice vote.

actionItems: Community development to work through funding for the 207 North 1st Avenue demolition project before an award recommendation is brought back to the board
Payment of $8,285 to Pember Company for Sidewalk Repair Project A Pay Estimate No. 3 approved
Board entered closed session to deliberate on claims
